title: A2.1 Unit 2 quiz — Life stories
description: Past simple e irregulares, perguntas sobre o passado, past continuous, contar uma história e o percurso profissional.

options.text: I was born in 1995.
I born in 1995.
I am born in 1995.
taught
teached
thought
What happened at the meeting?
What did happen at the meeting?
What did happened at the meeting?

questions.question: Complete: "I ___ dinner when the power went off."

options.text: was cooking
am cooking
were cooking

questions.question: Complete: "___ we were waiting, Paulo called the technician."

options.text: While
During
Then

questions.question: Qual destas frases conta como acabou a história?

options.text: In the end, the driver brought it back.
At the end, the driver brought it back.
Finally of the story, the driver brought it back.

questions.question: "I pretend to change jobs" quer dizer:

options.text: Finjo que vou mudar de emprego.
Pretendo mudar de emprego.
Mudei de emprego.

questions.explanation: Falso amigo: pretend = fingir. "Pretendo" = "I want to".

questions.question: Ouviu: "I was working in my uncle's shop when a friend told me about a job in Angola." O que aconteceu primeiro?

options.text: Ele já trabalhava na loja do tio.
O amigo falou-lhe do emprego.
Ele foi para Angola.

questions.explanation: O past continuous é a acção que já estava a decorrer.

questions.question: Para terminar "Tell me about yourself", qual é a melhor frase?

options.text: Now I'm a team leader, and this month I'm working on a new project.
Now I was a team leader.
Now I am work on a new project.

questions.question: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 1). Choose the correct sentence.

options.text: I need more time this week.
I'm needing more time this week.
I needing more time this week.

questions.question: Reciclagem (A2, unidade 1). "What's your new colleague like?" — Choose the answer.

options.text: He's very helpful, but a bit shy.
He's tall and he has a beard.
He likes football.

questions.question: Reciclagem (A1, unidade 10). Choose the correct sentence.

options.text: Next year I'm going to apply for a new job.
Next year I going to apply for a new job.
Next year I'm going to applied for a new job.
